material.acceptance_criteria: The mod LSP publishes syntax and engine-validation diagnostics for .lua buffers, and advertises completion and hover for them, using the same validator path as .star.
material.description: rust/crates/mod-lsp/src/main.rs:139-141 is_star accepts only .star; publish (main.rs:118-137) returns an empty diagnostics list for any other URI, and completion/hover (main.rs:85-104) also return nothing for .lua. The spike mod rust/crates/spike/mods/unit_mod.lua therefore gets no editor feedback.
material.resolution: Lua mods get line-numbered load diagnostics via ModHost::load, plus host-global completion and hover. CI breaks unit_mod.lua in RUNNER_TEMP and checks the diagnostic line. Duplication: host-global list lives in mod-lsp, not exported by mod-host.
material.subject: Mod LSP gives diagnostics only for .star, so .lua mods get none
material.witness_plan: CI step drives the mod-lsp binary over stdio with a didOpen of a broken .lua file and asserts a severity-1 publishDiagnostics for it.
